note: Grammar lessons of every level, grouped by what they help you say. Categories are shown in this order; inside a category the lessons run HSK 1 first, then HSK 2, then HSK 3 (the order of the lesson files).

categories.name: Building a sentence
categories.blurb: The skeleton of a sentence: who does what, 是, 有, 的 and pronouns.

categories.name: Doing things to things
categories.blurb: Move things and say what happens to them: 把 and 被.

categories.name: Describing and comparing
categories.blurb: Say what something is like, compare things, say how much, and say how well or how completely something is done.

categories.name: Questions
categories.blurb: Yes/no questions, question words, either-or questions, softening with 吧 and 呢, and question words that mean "any".

categories.name: Saying no, asking and telling
categories.blurb: Say no, make polite requests, and tell someone not to do something.

categories.name: Wanting and being able
categories.blurb: Want, can, may, hope, get ready, should, must and need.

categories.name: Numbers and counting
categories.blurb: Measure words, numbers, money, age, halves, rough numbers, and how much or how many.

categories.name: Time and how often
categories.blurb: Dates and clock time, how often something happens, when, and for how long.

categories.name: Where and direction
categories.blurb: Where something is or happens, distance, and which way things move.

categories.name: Happening now and soon
categories.blurb: Actions in progress, states that continue, and things about to happen.

categories.name: Finished and past
categories.blurb: Done, changed, already, experienced, just now, early or late, and describing how a past event happened.

categories.name: Joining people and ideas
categories.blurb: With, together, also, then, because and although, first and then, and at the same time: link people, actions and sentences.

categories.name: Conditions, reasons and topics
categories.blurb: If, as long as, only if, except, in order to, and "about": set conditions and link ideas.

categories.name: Opinions and guesses
categories.blurb: Say how things seem, what is probably true, and what is actually true.

categories.name: Old words, new meanings
categories.blurb: Words you already know that come back with another sound or meaning.
